overview: The Vertigo Trio, featuring vocalist Debbie Lane, performed a selection of jazz standards and contemporary arrangements at the West Medford Community Center as part of the 2026 Medford Jazz Festival.

items.title: Opening and Introduction
items.summary: The Vertigo Trio and vocalist Debbie Lane were introduced to the audience.

items.title: Mourning
items.summary: The ensemble performed the Claire Fisher composition "Mourning."

items.title: Walk Between the Raindrops
items.summary: The band played a rendition of Donald Fagen's "Walk Between the Raindrops."

items.title: Star Eyes
items.summary: Following an instrumental performance of "Nardis," the group performed the jazz standard "Star Eyes."

items.title: Vertigo
items.summary: The trio performed the John Abercrombie composition "Vertigo."

items.title: (They Long to Be) Close to You
items.summary: The group performed the Burt Bacharach and Hal David classic, which included audience participation.

items.title: Secret Love
items.summary: The ensemble performed a rendition of the song "Secret Love."

items.title: Acknowledgments and Band Introductions
items.summary: Debbie Lane thanked the festival organizers and volunteers while introducing band members Tim Blackman on keyboard, Ethan Folk on bass, and Doug Tolan on drums.

items.title: You Taught My Heart to Sing
items.summary: The performance concluded with a rendition of McCoy Tyner's "You Taught My Heart to Sing."
